claim: Talabat noticed that many of its Aurora queries could be cached and chose Amazon ElastiCache. During the migration, using Amazon ElastiCache improved the performance of Aurora further by reducing latency and easing the backend database load.

evidence.quote: Talabat noticed that many of its Aurora queries were able to be cached, so the company chose to use Amazon ElastiCache—a fully managed, in-memory caching service supporting flexible, near-real-time use cases. Using Amazon ElastiCache improved the performance of Aurora even further during the migration by reducing latency and easing the backend database load.
